verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a 'full REST API for interacting with the application' with concrete endpoints: a toggle-feature endpoint for automation from deploy scripts and an experiment-results endpoint. Its official MCP server works by making authenticated calls to that same REST API. However, nothing shows UI-to-API parity: there is no endpoint coverage list or published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and risky API changes can be held until a person confirms them in the UI. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage of metrics/fact tables, approval flows, visual editor and settings, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
